Description: The penetration rate in the e-commerce market in the Philippines was modeled to stand at 19.32 percent in 2024. From 2017 to 2024, the penetration rate rose by 3.82 percentage points, though the increase followed an uneven trajectory rather than a
consistent upward trend. Between 2024 and 2029, the penetration rate will rise by 12.57 percentage points, showing an overall upward trend with periodic ups and downs. Read more
Note(s): Philippines; 2017 to 2029
Source(s): Statista; Statista Market Insights
